in_sanskrit.name: तापेश्वर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who controls the god Tapesh or Lord of Shiva

in_hindi.name: तापेश्वर
in_hindi.long_meaning: राजा किया जाता है जो तापेश (Lord Shiva) को सामर्थ्य देता है

in_marathi.name: Tapeshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tapeshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tapeshwar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tapas' which means 'Heat' or 'Penance' and 'Ishwar' which means 'God'. The name Tapeshwar signifies the one who has mastered the heat of penance and is the Lord of the Universe.

in_bengali.name: Tapeshwar

The name Tapeshwar signifies the one who has mastered the heat of penance and is the Lord of the Universe.
